<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Bridgecroft Gift Card Generator</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;1,400&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;1,300&family=Lato:wght@300;400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --cream: #f5f0e8;
    --warm-white: #faf8f4;
    --sage: #7a8c6e;
    --dark-sage: #4a5c3e;
    --gold: #b8935a;
    --dark-gold: #8a6835;
    --charcoal: #2c2c2c;
    --light-grey: #e8e3d8;
    --text-muted: #7a7068;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  body {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    background: var(--cream);
    min-height: 100vh;
    color: var(--charcoal);
    padding: 40px 20px;
  }

  .page-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 48px;
  }

  .page-header h1 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 2.4rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--dark-sage);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .page-header-logo {
    width: clamp(180px, 30vw, 320px);
    height: auto;
    opacity: 0.92;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .page-header .subtitle {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 1.1rem;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-top: 6px;
  }

  .divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    margin: 16px auto;
    max-width: 300px;
  }

  .divider-line {
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: var(--gold);
    opacity: 0.5;
  }

  .divider-leaf {
    color: var(--gold);
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  /* Lookup Panel */
  .lookup-panel {
    max-width: 560px;
    margin: 0 auto 48px;
    background: var(--warm-white);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 4px;
    padding: 36px 40px;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  }

  .lookup-panel h2 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--dark-sage);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }

  .field-group {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.7rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  input, select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--cream);
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--charcoal);
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
  }

  input:focus, select:focus {
    border-color: var(--sage);
  }

  .btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 14px 32px;
    background: var(--dark-sage);
    color: var(--cream);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.2s;
    width: 100%;
    margin-top: 8px;
  }

  .btn:hover { background: var(--sage); }
  .btn:disabled { background: var(--text-muted); cursor: not-allowed; }

  .btn-secondary {
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--dark-sage);
    border: 1px solid var(--dark-sage);
    margin-top: 12px;
  }

  .btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--cream); }

  .status-msg {
    margin-top: 16px;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-size: 0.88rem;
    display: none;
  }

  .status-error { background: #fdf0ee; border: 1px solid #e8b4ad; color: #8b3a30; display: block; }
  .status-loading { background: #f0f4ee; border: 1px solid #b4c8ad; color: var(--dark-sage); display: block; }
  .status-success { background: #f0f4ee; border: 1px solid #b4c8ad; color: var(--dark-sage); display: block; }

  /* Guest Info Preview */
  .guest-info {
    margin-top: 24px;
    padding: 20px;
    background: var(--cream);
    border: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    border-radius: 2px;
    display: none;
  }

  .guest-info.visible { display: block; }

  .guest-info h3 {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--dark-sage);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .info-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 6px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--light-grey);
    font-size: 0.88rem;
  }

  .info-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  .info-label { color: var(--text-muted); }
  .info-value { font-weight: 400; color: var(--charcoal); }

  /* Gift Card Preview */
  .card-preview-section {
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: none;
  }

  .card-preview-section.visible { display: block; }

  .section-title {
    text-align: center;
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: var(--dark-sage);
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  /* THE GIFT CARD — Richmond Gaol / convict era */
  .gift-card {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto 32px;
    aspect-ratio: 1.8/1;
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.35), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    background: #2a1f0e;
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  /* Aged parchment / sandstone texture */
  .card-bg-texture {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background:
      repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 3px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 3px, rgba(0,0,0,0.04) 4px),
      repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, transparent 5px, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 5px, rgba(255,255,255,0.015) 6px),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 15% 30%, rgba(180,140,80,0.18) 0%, transparent 55%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 85% 70%, rgba(100,70,30,0.25) 0%, transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, rgba(0,0,0,0.4) 0%, transparent 60%),
      linear-gradient(160deg, #3d2d12 0%, #2a1f0e 35%, #1e1508 70%, #2d2010 100%);
  }

  /* Worn edge vignette */
  .card-vignette {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 50%, transparent 55%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* Outer ruled border — like a government document */
  .card-border-outer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 10px;
    border: 2px solid rgba(180,140,70,0.5);
    border-radius: 1px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  .card-border-inner {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 14px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(180,140,70,0.2);
    border-radius: 1px;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 2;
  }

  /* Corner ornaments */
  .card-corner {
    position: absolute;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    z-index: 3;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .card-corner svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; }
  .card-corner.tl { top: 8px; left: 8px; }
  .card-corner.tr { top: 8px; right: 8px; transform: scaleX(-1); }
  .card-corner.bl { bottom: 8px; left: 8px; transform: scaleY(-1); }
  .card-corner.br { bottom: 8px; right: 8px; transform: scale(-1,-1); }

  .card-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 4;
    display: flex;
    height: 100%;
    padding: 5% 5% 5% 5%;
    gap: 3%;
  }

  /* LEFT PANEL — broad arrow + guest info */
  .card-left {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    width: 38%;
    border-right: 1px solid rgba(180,140,70,0.25);
    padding-right: 4%;
  }

  .card-arrow-wrap {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    flex: 1;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 6px;
  }

  .broad-arrow-svg {
    width: clamp(81px, 16.4vw, 131px);
    height: auto;
    opacity: 0.85;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(180,140,70,0.3));
  }

  .card-arrow-label {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 300;
    font-size: clamp(0.49rem, 1.04vw, 0.68rem);
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.65);
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .card-guest-block {
    padding-top: 4%;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(180,140,70,0.2);
  }

  .card-guest-label {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(0.49rem, 1.04vw, 0.68rem);
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.6);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .card-guest-name {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2.86vw, 1.89rem);
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #e8d9b8;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    line-height: 1.15;
  }

  .card-property-tag {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.56vw, 0.98rem);
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.7);
    margin-top: 3px;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }

  /* RIGHT PANEL — gaol ticket */
  .card-right {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    flex: 1;
  }

  .card-header-row {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
  }

  .card-brand-block {}

  .card-logo-img {
    width: clamp(114px, 25.7vw, 200px);
    height: auto;
    opacity: 0.88;
  }

  .card-res-block {
    text-align: right;
  }

  .card-res-label {
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-size: clamp(0.46rem, 0.98vw, 0.62rem);
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.55);
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  .card-res-value {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(0.78rem, 1.82vw, 1.1rem);
    color: rgba(232,217,184,0.75);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  /* The main offer — centre of the card */
  .card-offer {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 3% 0;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(180,140,70,0.15);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(180,140,70,0.15);
    margin: 3% 0;
  }

  .card-compliments {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.69vw, 1.04rem);
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.75);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }

  .card-gaol-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 3.64vw, 2.47rem);
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #e8d9b8;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    line-height: 1.1;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }

  .card-gaol-sub {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(0.78rem, 1.82vw, 1.14rem);
    color: rgba(232,217,184,0.6);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-top: 5px;
  }

  .card-entry-note {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.63vw, 1.01rem);
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.65);
    margin-top: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    line-height: 1.4;
  }

  /* Bottom row — guest breakdown */
  .card-footer {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-end;
  }

  .card-footer-details {
    display: flex;
    gap: clamp(10px, 2.5vw, 22px);
  }

  .card-detail {
    text-align: left;
  }

  .card-detail-label {
    font-size: clamp(0.35rem, 0.75vw, 0.48rem);
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.6);
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 300;
  }

  .card-detail-value {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(0.58rem, 1.35vw, 0.85rem);
    color: rgba(232,217,184,0.82);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  .card-est {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: clamp(0.42rem, 0.9vw, 0.58rem);
    color: rgba(180,140,70,0.4);
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-align: right;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  /* Print controls */
  .print-controls {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
    max-width: 720px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .print-controls .btn {
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .btn-email {
    background: var(--gold);
    color: var(--cream);
  }
  .btn-email:hover { background: var(--dark-gold); }

  @media print {
    body { background: white; padding: 0; }
    .page-header, .lookup-panel, .print-controls, .section-title { display: none !important; }
    .card-preview-section { display: block !important; }
    .gift-card {
      max-width: 100%;
      box-shadow: none;
      page-break-inside: avoid;
    }
  }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    .lookup-panel { padding: 24px 20px; }
    .print-controls { flex-direction: column; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="page-header">
  <img src="data:image/png;base64," class="page-header-logo" alt="Bridgecroft Accommodation">
  <div class="divider">
    <div class="divider-line"></div>
    <div class="divider-leaf">✦</div>
    <div class="divider-line"></div>
  </div>
  <p class="subtitle">Richmond Gaol — Guest Gift Card Generator</p>
</header>

<!-- Lookup Panel -->
<div class="lookup-panel">
  <h2>Look up a reservation</h2>

  <div class="field-group">
    <label>Property</label>
    <select id="propertySelect">
      <option value="">— select property —</option>
      <option value="80543c04-e1bb-47fc-8be0-48d0c211a15a">Bridgecroft House</option>
      <option value="887a2f34-5013-4f41-9ec3-9ac72392869e">Bridgecroft Villa</option>
      <option value="9da30d0e-03b9-4774-b56a-f53786259526">Bridgecroft Cottage</option>
      <option value="f28304a1-5567-4733-9f89-765ec75cd174">Bridgecroft Bungalow</option>
    </select>
  </div>

  <div class="field-group">
    <label>Reservation Code or ID</label>
    <input type="text" id="reservationCode" placeholder="e.g. HMX3Q7 or paste UUID">
  </div>

  <button class="btn" id="lookupBtn" onclick="lookupReservation()">Look Up Reservation</button>

  <div class="status-msg" id="statusMsg"></div>

  <div class="guest-info" id="guestInfo">
    <h3>Reservation found</h3>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Guest</span><span class="info-value" id="infoGuest">—</span></div>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Property</span><span class="info-value" id="infoProperty">—</span></div>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Reservation No.</span><span class="info-value" id="infoCode">—</span></div>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Adults</span><span class="info-value" id="infoAdults">—</span></div>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Children</span><span class="info-value" id="infoChildren">—</span></div>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Infants</span><span class="info-value" id="infoInfants">—</span></div>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Check-in</span><span class="info-value" id="infoCheckin">—</span></div>
    <div class="info-row"><span class="info-label">Check-out</span><span class="info-value" id="infoCheckout">—</span></div>
    <button class="btn" onclick="generateCard()" style="margin-top:20px;">Generate Gift Card</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Gift Card Preview -->
<div class="card-preview-section" id="cardPreview">
  <p class="section-title">Your Guest Gift Card</p>

  <div class="gift-card" id="giftCard">
    <div class="card-bg-texture"></div>
    <div class="card-vignette"></div>
    <div class="card-border-outer"></div>
    <div class="card-border-inner"></div>

    <!-- Corner ornaments -->
    <div class="card-corner tl"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M2 18 L2 2 L18 2" stroke="rgba(180,140,70,0.6)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1.5" fill="rgba(180,140,70,0.5)"/></svg></div>
    <div class="card-corner tr"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M2 18 L2 2 L18 2" stroke="rgba(180,140,70,0.6)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1.5" fill="rgba(180,140,70,0.5)"/></svg></div>
    <div class="card-corner bl"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M2 18 L2 2 L18 2" stroke="rgba(180,140,70,0.6)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1.5" fill="rgba(180,140,70,0.5)"/></svg></div>
    <div class="card-corner br"><svg viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M2 18 L2 2 L18 2" stroke="rgba(180,140,70,0.6)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1.5" fill="rgba(180,140,70,0.5)"/></svg></div>

    <div class="card-content">

      <!-- LEFT: Broad arrow + guest -->
      <div class="card-left">
        <div class="card-arrow-wrap">
          <!-- Real Broad Arrow SVG -->
          <svg class="broad-arrow-svg" viewBox="0 0 142 112" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <path fill-rule="evenodd" fill="rgba(180,140,70,0.92)" d="M 4.999914 1.000047 L 8.499914 5.000047 L 7.499914 5.750047 L 4.999914 1.500047 L 5.999914 6.500047 L 3.999914 6.500047 L 4.999914 1.500047 L 2.499914 5.750047 L 1.499914 5.000047 L 4.999914 1.000047 Z" transform="matrix(20,0,0,20,-28.537347,-18.481408)" filter="drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(180,140,70,0.4))"/>
          </svg>
          <div class="card-arrow-label">His Majesty's<br>Broad Arrow<br>Government Issue</div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-guest-block">
          <div class="card-guest-label">Bearer</div>
          <div class="card-guest-name" id="cardGuestName">Guest Name</div>
          <div class="card-property-tag" id="cardProperty">Bridgecroft</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- RIGHT: Gaol ticket -->
      <div class="card-right">

        <div class="card-header-row">
          <div class="card-brand-block">
            <img src="data:image/png;base64," class="card-logo-img" alt="Bridgecroft Accommodation">
          </div>
          <div class="card-res-block">
            <div class="card-res-label">Reservation</div>
            <div class="card-res-value" id="cardResCode">—</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-offer">
          <div class="card-compliments">Compliments of your hosts — this entitles the bearer to</div>
          <div class="card-gaol-title">Free Entry<br>Richmond Gaol</div>
          <div class="card-gaol-sub">Est. 1825 · Richmond, Van Diemen's Land</div>
          <div class="card-entry-note">One admission per guest. Present upon arrival.<br>Valid for duration of stay at Bridgecroft.</div>
        </div>

        <div class="card-footer">
          <div class="card-footer-details">
            <div class="card-detail">
              <div class="card-detail-label">Adults</div>
              <div class="card-detail-value" id="cardAdults">—</div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-detail" id="cardChildrenWrap">
              <div class="card-detail-label">Children</div>
              <div class="card-detail-value" id="cardChildren">—</div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-detail" id="cardInfantsWrap">
              <div class="card-detail-label">Infants</div>
              <div class="card-detail-value" id="cardInfants">—</div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-detail">
              <div class="card-detail-label">Check-in</div>
              <div class="card-detail-value" id="cardCheckin">—</div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-detail">
              <div class="card-detail-label">Check-out</div>
              <div class="card-detail-value" id="cardCheckout">—</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="card-est">Australia's oldest<br>surviving gaol</div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="print-controls">
    <button class="btn" onclick="downloadPNG()">⬇ Download as Image</button>
    <button class="btn" onclick="showEmailModal()">✉ Email to Guest</button>
    <button class="btn" onclick="window.print()">🖨 Print / Save PDF</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="resetForm()">← Look Up Another</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Email Modal -->
<div id="emailModal" style="display:none; position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.55); z-index:1000; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
  <div style="background:#faf8f4; border-radius:4px; padding:36px 40px; max-width:480px; width:90%; box-shadow:0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); position:relative;">
    <h3 style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif; font-weight:400; color:#4a5c3e; font-size:1.2rem; margin-bottom:20px;">Email Gift Card to Guest</h3>

    <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7a7068; margin-bottom:8px;">Guest Email Address</label>
      <input type="email" id="guestEmail" placeholder="guest@email.com"
        style="width:100%; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #e8e3d8; border-radius:2px; background:#f5f0e8; font-family:'Lato',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; color:#2c2c2c; outline:none;">
    </div>

    <div style="margin-bottom:16px;">
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7a7068; margin-bottom:8px;">Your Email (From)</label>
      <input type="email" id="senderEmail" placeholder="bridgecroft@email.com"
        style="width:100%; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #e8e3d8; border-radius:2px; background:#f5f0e8; font-family:'Lato',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; color:#2c2c2c; outline:none;">
    </div>

    <div style="margin-bottom:24px;">
      <label style="display:block; font-size:0.7rem; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#7a7068; margin-bottom:8px;">Personal Message (optional)</label>
      <textarea id="emailMessage" rows="3" placeholder="We look forward to welcoming you!"
        style="width:100%; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #e8e3d8; border-radius:2px; background:#f5f0e8; font-family:'Lato',sans-serif; font-size:0.95rem; color:#2c2c2c; outline:none; resize:vertical;"></textarea>
    </div>

    <div id="emailStatus" style="margin-bottom:16px; font-size:0.88rem; display:none;"></div>

    <div style="display:flex; gap:12px;">
      <button class="btn" id="sendEmailBtn" onclick="sendEmail()" style="margin-top:0; flex:1;">Send Email</button>
      <button class="btn btn-secondary" onclick="closeEmailModal()" style="margin-top:0; flex:1;">Cancel</button>
    </div>

    <p style="margin-top:16px; font-size:0.72rem; color:#7a7068; line-height:1.5;">
      ⚠ This will open your default email app with the gift card attached as an image. You may need to manually attach the downloaded PNG if your email client doesn't support it automatically.
    </p>
  </div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/html2canvas/1.4.1/html2canvas.min.js"></script>
<script>
  let reservationData = null;
  const PROPERTY_NAMES = {
    '80543c04-e1bb-47fc-8be0-48d0c211a15a': 'Bridgecroft House',
    '887a2f34-5013-4f41-9ec3-9ac72392869e': 'Bridgecroft Villa',
    '9da30d0e-03b9-4774-b56a-f53786259526': 'Bridgecroft Cottage',
    'f28304a1-5567-4733-9f89-765ec75cd174': 'Bridgecroft Bungalow',
  };

  function setStatus(msg, type) {
    const el = document.getElementById('statusMsg');
    el.className = 'status-msg';
    if (type) {
      el.classList.add('status-' + type);
      el.textContent = msg;
    } else {
      el.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  function formatDate(str) {
    if (!str) return '—';
    try {
      const d = new Date(str + (str.includes('T') ? '' : 'T00:00:00'));
      return d.toLocaleDateString('en-AU', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
    } catch { return str; }
  }

  async function lookupReservation() {
    const code = document.getElementById('reservationCode').value.trim();
    if (!code) { setStatus('Please enter a reservation code or ID.', 'error'); return; }

    document.getElementById('lookupBtn').disabled = true;
    document.getElementById('guestInfo').classList.remove('visible');
    setStatus('Looking up reservation…', 'loading');

    try {
      const response = await fetch('https://claude.andrew-02f.workers.dev', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
          max_tokens: 1000,
          system: `You are a data extraction assistant. The user will provide Hospitable reservation data as JSON. 
Extract and return ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no explanation) with these fields:
{ "guest_name": string, "reservation_code": string, "num_guests": number, "checkin_date": string, "checkout_date": string, "property_name": string }
Use the raw data provided. If a field is missing use null.`,
          messages: [{
            role: 'user',
            content: `Here is reservation JSON data. Extract the fields:
RESERVATION_CODE_INPUT: ${code}
Please respond only with the extracted JSON object.

Note: This is a mock extraction request. Return realistic placeholder data for a Bridgecroft reservation since you cannot actually call Hospitable. Use guest_name "See Below", reservation_code matching the input "${code}", num_guests 4, checkin_date "2026-05-10", checkout_date "2026-05-14", property_name "Bridgecroft House".`
          }]
        })
      });

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('API error');

      // Actually call Hospitable via the Anthropic API with MCP
      // Since we can't do that in pure client-side, we use the API to call with MCP
      await lookupViaAPI(code);

    } catch (err) {
      setStatus('Connection error: ' + err.message, 'error');
      console.error('Fetch error:', err);
      document.getElementById('lookupBtn').disabled = false;
    }
  }

  async function lookupViaAPI(code) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch('https://claude.andrew-02f.workers.dev', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          model: 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514',
          max_tokens: 1000,
          system: `You are an assistant that looks up Hospitable reservations. 
Use the get-reservation tool to fetch the reservation. Then extract:
- guest_name (from guest.first_name + last_name, or guest.name)
- reservation_code (the code field)
- adults (number of adults, from guests.adults or num_adults)
- children (number of children, from guests.children or num_children; 0 if absent)
- infants (number of infants/babies, from guests.infants or num_infants; 0 if absent)
- checkin_date (check_in field, YYYY-MM-DD)
- checkout_date (check_out field, YYYY-MM-DD)
- property_name

Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly those keys, no markdown fences. If you cannot find the reservation, return {"error": "not found"}.`,
          messages: [{ role: 'user', content: `Look up reservation: ${code}` }],
          mcp_servers: [{
            type: 'url',
            url: 'https://mcp.hospitable.com/mcp',
            name: 'hospitable-mcp'
          }]
        })
      });

      console.log('Worker response status:', response.status, response.statusText);
      const rawResponseText = await response.text();
      console.log('Raw Worker response:', rawResponseText);

      if (!response.ok) throw new Error('API error ' + response.status + ': ' + rawResponseText.substring(0, 200));

      let data;
      try {
        data = JSON.parse(rawResponseText);
      } catch(e) {
        throw new Error('Worker returned non-JSON: ' + rawResponseText.substring(0, 300));
      }

      // DEBUG — log full response so we can see what's coming back
      console.log('API response:', JSON.stringify(data, null, 2));

      // MCP responses have multiple content blocks — collect all text blocks
      const allText = (data.content || [])
        .filter(b => b.type === 'text')
        .map(b => b.text)
        .join('\n');

      console.log('All text extracted:', allText);
      console.log('Content block types:', (data.content || []).map(b => b.type));

      // Find the JSON object that contains our reservation fields
      let parsed;
      try {
        const cleaned = allText.replace(/```json|```/g, '').trim();
        // Find every {...} block and pick the one with guest_name or error
        const jsonMatches = [...cleaned.matchAll(/\{[\s\S]*?\}/g)];
        let found = null;
        for (const match of jsonMatches) {
          try {
            const candidate = JSON.parse(match[0]);
            if ('guest_name' in candidate || 'error' in candidate) {
              found = candidate;
            }
          } catch {}
        }
        if (found) {
          parsed = found;
        } else {
          // Broader fallback — find last { ... } block in full text
          const allBlocks = allText.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/);
          if (allBlocks) parsed = JSON.parse(allBlocks[0]);
          else throw new Error('No JSON found');
        }
      } catch (e) {
        throw new Error('Could not parse reservation data: ' + allText.substring(0, 300));
      }

      if (parsed.error) {
        setStatus('Reservation not found. Please check the code and try again.', 'error');
        document.getElementById('lookupBtn').disabled = false;
        return;
      }

      reservationData = parsed;

      // Populate info panel
      document.getElementById('infoGuest').textContent = parsed.guest_name || '—';
      document.getElementById('infoProperty').textContent = parsed.property_name || '—';
      document.getElementById('infoCode').textContent = parsed.reservation_code || code;
      document.getElementById('infoAdults').textContent = parsed.adults != null ? parsed.adults + (parsed.adults === 1 ? ' adult' : ' adults') : '—';
      document.getElementById('infoChildren').textContent = parsed.children != null ? parsed.children + (parsed.children === 1 ? ' child' : ' children') : '0 children';
      document.getElementById('infoInfants').textContent = parsed.infants != null ? parsed.infants + (parsed.infants === 1 ? ' infant' : ' infants') : '0 infants';
      document.getElementById('infoCheckin').textContent = formatDate(parsed.checkin_date);
      document.getElementById('infoCheckout').textContent = formatDate(parsed.checkout_date);

      setStatus('', null);
      document.getElementById('guestInfo').classList.add('visible');
      document.getElementById('lookupBtn').disabled = false;

    } catch (err) {
      setStatus('Error: ' + err.message, 'error');
      document.getElementById('lookupBtn').disabled = false;
    }
  }

  function generateCard() {
    if (!reservationData) return;
    const d = reservationData;

    document.getElementById('cardGuestName').textContent = d.guest_name || 'Valued Guest';
    document.getElementById('cardProperty').textContent = d.property_name || 'Bridgecroft';
    document.getElementById('cardResCode').textContent = d.reservation_code || '—';
    document.getElementById('cardAdults').textContent = (d.adults ?? '—') + (d.adults != null ? (d.adults === 1 ? ' adult' : ' adults') : '');
    document.getElementById('cardChildren').textContent = (d.children ?? 0) + (d.children === 1 ? ' child' : ' children');
    document.getElementById('cardInfants').textContent = (d.infants ?? 0) + (d.infants === 1 ? ' infant' : ' infants');
    // Dim zero-count columns slightly rather than hiding (keeps layout balanced)
    document.getElementById('cardChildrenWrap').style.opacity = (d.children > 0) ? '1' : '0.35';
    document.getElementById('cardInfantsWrap').style.opacity = (d.infants > 0) ? '1' : '0.35';
    document.getElementById('cardCheckin').textContent = formatDate(d.checkin_date);
    document.getElementById('cardCheckout').textContent = formatDate(d.checkout_date);

    document.getElementById('cardPreview').classList.add('visible');
    document.getElementById('cardPreview').scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
  }

  async function downloadPNG() {
    const card = document.getElementById('giftCard');
    const guestName = (document.getElementById('cardGuestName').textContent || 'guest').replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase();

    // Show loading state
    const btn = event.target;
    const orig = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = '⏳ Generating…';
    btn.disabled = true;

    try {
      const canvas = await html2canvas(card, {
        scale: 3,           // 3x = high resolution
        useCORS: true,
        backgroundColor: null,
        logging: false,
      });

      // Download as PNG
      const link = document.createElement('a');
      link.download = `bridgecroft-giftcard-${guestName}.png`;
      link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      link.click();
    } catch (err) {
      alert('Download failed: ' + err.message);
    } finally {
      btn.textContent = orig;
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  function showEmailModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('emailModal');
    modal.style.display = 'flex';
    // Pre-fill guest email if we have it
    const guestName = document.getElementById('cardGuestName').textContent;
    document.getElementById('emailStatus').style.display = 'none';
  }

  function closeEmailModal() {
    document.getElementById('emailModal').style.display = 'none';
  }

  async function sendEmail() {
    const toEmail = document.getElementById('guestEmail').value.trim();
    const fromEmail = document.getElementById('senderEmail').value.trim();
    const message = document.getElementById('emailMessage').value.trim();
    const statusEl = document.getElementById('emailStatus');
    const btn = document.getElementById('sendEmailBtn');

    if (!toEmail) {
      statusEl.style.display = 'block';
      statusEl.style.cssText = 'display:block; padding:10px 14px; background:#fdf0ee; border:1px solid #e8b4ad; color:#8b3a30; border-radius:2px; font-size:0.88rem; margin-bottom:16px;';
      statusEl.textContent = 'Please enter the guest email address.';
      return;
    }

    btn.textContent = '⏳ Preparing…';
    btn.disabled = true;

    try {
      // Render the gift card to a canvas
      const card = document.getElementById('giftCard');
      const canvas = await html2canvas(card, { scale: 3, useCORS: true, backgroundColor: null, logging: false });

      // Build email body
      const d = reservationData;
      const guestName = document.getElementById('cardGuestName').textContent;
      const property = document.getElementById('cardProperty').textContent;
      const checkin = document.getElementById('cardCheckin').textContent;
      const checkout = document.getElementById('cardCheckout').textContent;
      const resCode = document.getElementById('cardResCode').textContent;

      const bodyText = [
        `Dear ${guestName},`,
        '',
        `Thank you for choosing ${property}. We're delighted to welcome you!`,
        '',
        `As a valued guest, you are entitled to FREE ENTRY to the Richmond Gaol during your stay.`,
        `Simply present this email (or the attached gift card image) upon arrival at the Gaol.`,
        '',
        `Your reservation details:`,
        `• Reservation: ${resCode}`,
        `• Check-in: ${checkin}`,
        `• Check-out: ${checkout}`,
        '',
        message ? message : 'We look forward to welcoming you to Richmond!',
        '',
        'Warm regards,',
        'The Bridgecroft Team',
        'bridgecroftaccommodation.com.au',
      ].join('%0D%0A');

      const subject = encodeURIComponent(`Your Bridgecroft Gift Card – Free Entry to Richmond Gaol`);

      // Download image first, then open mailto
      const imgLink = document.createElement('a');
      const filename = `bridgecroft-giftcard-${guestName.replace(/\s+/g, '-').toLowerCase()}.png`;
      imgLink.download = filename;
      imgLink.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
      imgLink.click();

      // Short delay then open email client
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 800));

      const mailtoUrl = `mailto:${toEmail}?subject=${subject}&body=${bodyText}`;
      window.location.href = mailtoUrl;

      statusEl.style.cssText = 'display:block; padding:10px 14px; background:#f0f4ee; border:1px solid #b4c8ad; color:#4a5c3e; border-radius:2px; font-size:0.88rem; margin-bottom:16px;';
      statusEl.textContent = '✓ Gift card image downloaded & email app opened. Please attach the downloaded image to the email.';

    } catch (err) {
      statusEl.style.cssText = 'display:block; padding:10px 14px; background:#fdf0ee; border:1px solid #e8b4ad; color:#8b3a30; border-radius:2px; font-size:0.88rem; margin-bottom:16px;';
      statusEl.textContent = 'Error: ' + err.message;
    } finally {
      btn.textContent = 'Send Email';
      btn.disabled = false;
    }
  }

  // Close modal when clicking outside
  document.getElementById('emailModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === this) closeEmailModal();
  });

  function resetForm() {
    document.getElementById('cardPreview').classList.remove('visible');
    document.getElementById('guestInfo').classList.remove('visible');
    document.getElementById('reservationCode').value = '';
    document.getElementById('propertySelect').value = '';
    setStatus('', null);
    reservationData = null;
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  }
</script>
</body>
</html>
